answer: Because the jade pair is tracked in the saffron ledger, the tundra audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 101 identities means 101 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Full reward requires answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 47%. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
